question: The maximum strength of the Lower House of Parliament is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**552.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Lower House of Parliament** is also known as the **Lok Sabha.**
 
• It is the** directly elected house** of the Indian Parliament.
 
• The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha is fixed at** 552 members.**
 
• Out of these 552 members, **530 are elected **from the states,** 20** from the **Union Territories **and **2 members **are nominated by the President of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Rajya Sabha currently has a sanctioned strength of **250**, but this number may be raised through **constitutional amendment.**
